name: Tooltip
summary: Brief label revealed on hover or focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger, as a single element. It receives aria-describedby pointing at the popup — that reference is what makes the hint exist for a screen reader instead of only for the eye.

props.name: content
props.description: The hint. Short, and never the only place the information lives: a tooltip is a description, and it must hold nothing focusable.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side; it flips when there is no room.
